description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md and identify the request keyword '자세히' → triggering 풀 모드 (Full Mode), not Sprint Mode. 2. The agent must identify the topic as '사업성 검토' (business feasibility review) type. 3. The agent must consult ai-meeting-room/references/agent-roles.md to auto-select 3-5 relevant expert agents for F&B topics (e.g., 스카우트, 애널, 카피, 리걸) PLUS the mandatory 😈 데빌 and 🦁 리오(의장). 4. The agent must produce a free-dialogue debate in ping-pong format (1-2 sentence turns, agents interrupting each other) — NOT the banned monologue format. The debate must include: at minimum 15 agent speaking turns, at least 2 direct name-calling rebuttals (e.g., '애널, 그 숫자 어디서 나온 거야?'), at least 1 opinion change admission, at least 2 extreme Devil questions. 5. Every agent utterance must contain 2+ quality elements from the Quality Gate: concrete numbers+sources (e.g., '통계청 2025 기준 XX억'), real failure cases, time-framed actions, customer 1st-person perspective, or exposed thought process. 6. The full 풀 모드 output structure must include all 9 mandatory sections: 자문 정보, 30초 요약, 사전 리서치 브리핑, 토론 전문, 핵심 논점 & 합의 table (with 🟢🟡🔴 indicators), 미합의 & 리스크, 데빌의 최종 quote, 액션 아이템 as a decision-tree table (success→A, failure→B format), and 다음 자문 안건. 7. The conclusion must explicitly state Go / No-Go / 조건부 Go. 8. Forbidden phrases ('시장 조사를 하세요', '차별화하세요' without specifics, '검토가 필요합니다', etc.) must be absent. 9. The final output is saved as meeting_report.md.
